domains.label: General Purpose
domains.rationale: The talk is an opening keynote for the AI Engineer Code Summit, a developer-focused event, framing the platform and agenda for builders attending the summit. The speaker describes 10x.co as an AI transformation firm helping mid-market and enterprise companies adopt AI in their operations. The content centers on enterprise AI adoption and transformation rather than building, deploying, or operating specific systems. The talk is a non-technical welcome address with no prerequisite knowledge or technical depth required. The transcript is a conference opening keynote delivered by an MC welcoming attendees and previewing the event. All evidence anchors are directly said in the transcript and corroborate the framing and identity claims.

summary: Alex Lieberman opens the AI Engineer Code Summit 2025 by engaging the audience in a roll-call of locations, revealing attendees from New York, San Francisco, Austin, Ecuador, and as far as New Zealand. He introduces himself as co-founder of Morning Brew and MC for the day, addressing the apparent mismatch of a newsletter personality hosting an AI engineering conference. Lieberman explains that after departing Morning Brew, he sought a field offering consequential work and access to exceptional talent, leading him to AI. He co-founded 10x.co, described as an AI transformation firm helping mid-market and enterprise companies adopt AI. He notes he is the only non-technical person at his company. Lieberman characterizes the past year as a banner year for the industry and positions the summit as both a retrospective and a tactical forward-looking view. The agenda includes speakers from labs, unicorn AI startups, academics, management consultants, and Fortune 50 brands. He then acknowledges sponsors, starting with Google DeepMind as presenting sponsor, Anthropic as platinum sponsor, and gold and silver sponsors available in the expo area. The opening concludes with Lieberman energizing the audience to begin the event.
